decisions: Actual existing P0 evaluate_action is invoked with scoped bound task and measured owned-file metadata; no target actions.
Workspace observes owned workset inspection, not patch execution. Publication requires actual recorded commit and staged paths verified by fixed local Git reads.
Only dedicated observations lock/index is used; no checkpoint/publication recursion.
Immutable records/assessment files and mutable index are separate from submitted evidence. Same-snapshot cache expires explicitly.
Generated current-task records and evidence are excluded from workset to avoid self-invalidation; unchanged own commit does not stale workspace HEAD.
Reviews are declared not authenticated. Evaluator may accept correct deny; routine bounded allow can explicitly declare governance_not_required.
No raw contents/diffs/prompts/credentials, external network, signing, grant issuance or protected execution.
Non-HTTPS Git locations are hashed in workspace metadata and unsupported for publication observations; no fake URL.
R1: stored typed policy and deterministic input reconstruction bind every request/context semantic field to measured snapshot and time; stored result is replayed for consistency, not authenticated.
R2: linked assessments are distinct from resolved readiness; explicit verdict fields show revise/escalate/rework/inconclusive without a success-shaped result.
P0 deployment constrained to exact registered framework checkout; no external-clone assumption from UUID alone.
Cache does not skip integrity/semantic replay; unchanged observation record IDs remain stable until snapshot or expiry changes.

Timeout or unknown owner leaves an explicit observation_locked/not_ready state. Recovery is externally verified manual removal of only the exact lock; engine has no automatic lock deletion or process killing.
Explicit observe --refresh provides narrow immutable recovery from malformed/legacy cached records; optional supersession metadata preserves compatibility with valid existing observations.

Publication now binds the full immutable committed-object metadata manifest with an explicit content_basis, never raw worktree bytes or git-diff cleanliness. Workspace continues to use byte fingerprints and generated-record exclusions.
